perFileRecordResolution.coverageStatus: manual/manual-range rows are inspected at the declared depth; scan rows are classified from whole-file static text reads; excluded-active-owner rows are explicitly omitted from accepted dependency inspection.
perFileRecordResolution.targetPath: Every row retains its exact actualFilePath as the preservation target; an extraction row additionally references its mapping.publicViewTarget and mapping.consumerTarget. These are frozen-plan destinations, not claims that files or usable contracts exist.
perFileRecordResolution.preservationAction: Apply roleRules[role] and planMappings[acceptedPlanMapping].preservationAction; add edgeRules for each lexicalFrameworkCandidates character, then exactPathFindings when present.
perFileRecordResolution.blocker: Union roleRules[role].blockers, planMappings[acceptedPlanMapping].blockers, edgeRules[*].blocker and exactPathFindings[*].blocker. Empty lexical candidates means only no match for these scan patterns, never proof of purity.
perFileRecordResolution.reviewDepth: manual = complete text scanned and manually read in full; manual-range = complete scan plus the listed human-readable ranges; scan = entire safe text read by inert regex scanner, not manually reviewed in full; excluded-active-owner = not accepted/inspected as frozen dependency.
perFileRecordResolution.testOnly: Tests were fully read by static scan; their mocks/imports are not production edges and no test was executed.
